title: 段布局与体积：.bss 只记录长度，不占文件空间
expected_output:
$ gcc -c big.c -o big.o
$ objdump -h big.o      # 看 .bss 的 size 与段属性

big.o:     file format pe-x86-64

Sections:
Idx Name          Size      VMA               LMA               File off  Algn
  0 .text         00000050  0000000000000000  0000000000000000  0000012c  2**4
                  CONTENTS, ALLOC, LOAD, RELOC, READONLY, CODE
  1 .data         00000400  0000000000000000  0000000000000000  0000017c  2**5
                  CONTENTS, ALLOC, LOAD, DATA
  2 .bss          00100000  0000000000000000  0000000000000000  00000000  2**5
                  ALLOC
  3 .rdata        00000030  0000000000000000  0000000000000000  0000057c  2**4
                  CONTENTS, ALLOC, LOAD, READONLY, DATA
  4 .xdata        0000000c  0000000000000000  0000000000000000  000005ac  2**2
                  CONTENTS, ALLOC, LOAD, READONLY, DATA
  5 .pdata        0000000c  0000000000000000  0000000000000000  000005b8  2**2
                  CONTENTS, ALLOC, LOAD, RELOC, READONLY, DATA
  6 .rdata$zzz    00000050  0000000000000000  0000000000000000  000005c4  2**4
                  CONTENTS, ALLOC, LOAD, READONLY, DATA
$ size big.o            # text/data/bss 三段字节数
   text	   data	    bss	    dec	    hex	filename
    232	   1024	1048576	1049832	 1004e8	big.o
$ gcc big.o -o big.exe
$ size big.exe          # bss 约 1 MiB，但文件本身很小
   text	   data	    bss	    dec	    hex	filename
  36196	   1296	1051552	1089044	 109e14	big.exe
$ ./big
sections: bss[0]=x data[0]=1
_verify_note: expected_output 为 Windows + MinGW-w64（gcc 15.2 / binutils 2.45）真实执行捕获；脚本中显示的是可移植命令形式（gcc/ar/nm/objdump/size），本机实际以 D:/mingw64/bin/ 下的同名工具驱动，二者等价。
